measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $1.5 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for five school years, from 2027–28 through 2031–32, for school operations and maintenance. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $3.95 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit starting in the 2027–28 school year to maintain instructional programs, operations and services. This is an ongoing authorization with no scheduled end in the question.

Allows the district to raise $2.9 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for four school years, from 2026–27 through 2029–30. It would support educational programs, staff salaries and benefits, technology, maintenance and transportation. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $950,000 a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for seven school years, from 2027–28 through 2033–34. It would support operations and maintenance, including facilities, safety and security, student transportation and educational programs. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $3.5 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit starting in the 2027–28 school year for operations, maintenance and payments on debt for capital improvements. This is an ongoing authorization with no scheduled end in the question.

Allows the district to borrow up to $14 million through general-obligation bonds for school facilities. The projects include secure entrances and other safety improvements; building systems, infrastructure and major maintenance; renovations to teaching spaces; site and track improvements; and furnishings, fixtures and equipment.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize up to $14 million in bonds for these school-facility projects.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize these bonds through this question.
